test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

A party is being given by her on the occasion of her sixteenth birthday.

options.text: She will give a party on the occasion of her sixteenth birthday.
She is giving a party on the occasion of her sixteenth birthday.
She was giving a party on the occasion of her sixteenth birthday.
She has given a party on the occasion of her sixteenth birthday.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the **passive voice** and needs to be converted to the **active voice.**
 
• In the **passive voice,** the subject of the sentence (in this case **'her'**) **is the recipient of the action.**
 
• In the** active voice**, the subject of the sentence (in this case** 'She**')** performs **the** action.**
 
• The correct active form of the sentence should be in** the present continuous tense to match the passive construction 'is being given'.**
 
• Format = **Subject (she) + Verb (present continuous tense here) + Object (a party) + prepositional phrase (on the occasion of her sixteenth birthday.)**

Therefore, the correct active form is: '**She is giving a party on the occasion of her sixteenth birthday'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Other options are invalid due to incorrect tense used there.

 
• Option 1 = **Incorrect,** the tense used here is in future indefinite tense. It doesn't match with the tense given in the question.
 
• Option 2 =** Incorrect**, the tense used here is in past continuous tense. It doesn't match with the tense given in the question.
 
• Option 3 =** Incorrect**, the tense used here is in present perfect tense. It doesn't match with the tense given in the question.
